map.主桌数 = 向上取整(宾客数 ÷ 每桌人数)，每桌通常 10 人（大桌 12 人: Main tables = ceil(guests / seats per table), usually 10 per table (12 for large); suggest 1 reserve table (~5%–10%) for extra guests. Common halls hold 20–40 tables.
map.宾客 186 人、10 人/桌：主桌=ceil(186÷10)=19 桌，备 1: 186 guests at 10/table: main = ceil(186/10) = 19, plus 1–2 reserve → 20–21 tables; at 12/table, 186/12 ~ 15.5 → 16 tables. If the venue holds only 18, a split session or hall change is needed.
map.一般备 1 桌或按 5%~10% 上浮；婚宴常出现迟到/加人，备桌可退或转员工餐: Usually 1 table or up 5%–10%; weddings often have late/combo guests, and reserve tables can be returned or turned into staff meals per hotel rules.
